# Страна Цветов (PureGeo)

> Family-oriented summer camp in Batumi, Georgia for children 5–14 and their parents.

## About
- Website: https://puregeo-demo.vercel.app
- Focus: Children's summer language and adventure camp in central Batumi.
- Location: Batumi, Adjara, Georgia.
- Season: June – August (4 sessions of 20 days each).
- Formats: Full Day, City Days, Adventure League.
